propositions: Version manifests (pyproject.toml, server.json, docs/api-stability.md) must be bumped from 0.7.1 to 0.8.0 in lockstep and verified by test_version_sync.py
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] section must be retitled to [0.8.0] with corrected footer links and a fresh [Unreleased] section opened
docs/releasing.md runbook must be corrected to document Gerrit landing flow (refs/for/main) instead of direct git push to main
The release commit must land on main via Gerrit two-vote gate (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) before dispatch
release.yml must be dispatched from main with version=0.8.0, passing authorize job guards, and completing publish to PyPI, GitHub Release, and MCP Registry
